title: Depth of a circuit node
statement: For any natural number $n$, Boolean value $b$, and list $cs$ of circuits on $n$ variables, the depth of the node with gate type $b$ and children $cs$ is one plus the maximum depth among the children, where the maximum is zero when the list is empty.
hypotheses_covered: List cs of circuits on n variables
